GHSA-qwww-vcr4-c8h2.reason: React Router RSC-mode CSRF (action execution before 400). This app is a Vite SPA using declarative-mode react-router-dom only — no RSC, no framework mode, no server actions — so the vulnerable code path cannot execute. The only fixed version is react-router@8.3.0, which requires React 19.2.7+; remove this entry when the React 19 migration lands.
